keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across title and abstract (e.g. "prompt injection", "protein folding"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

category.title: arXiv category
category.description: arXiv category code to limit to, e.g. "cs.AI", "cs.CL", "stat.ML", "econ.GN", "q-bio.GN". Leave blank for all categories. Full list at arxiv.org/category_taxonomy.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by submission date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of papers to return, most recently submitted first.
